verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog documents private sub-teams for sensitive groups (linear-docs-15). It describes an explicit 'Private to team members' mode, where the sub-team is hidden from everyone except members directly invited, plus a parent-restricted option (linear-docs-40). Initiatives led by private teams are also visible only to team members (linear-docs-29, linear-docs-59). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth docs on who can create sub-teams and how membership is managed beyond changelog snippets.
